name: Tealium
description: Tealium is a customer data platform for collecting, governing, enriching, and activating event and visitor data across websites, applications, audiences, and downstream technology. Its products include iQ Tag Management, EventStream, AudienceStream, DataAccess, Predict, and consent and privacy tooling.
agentUseSummary: Bind one exact Tealium account and profile with no API credential; agents can read only identity-free audience and badge definition counts from Tealium's public Profile Definition API.

credentialRequirements.name: TEALIUM_ACCOUNT
credentialRequirements.label: Tealium account name
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind one exact Tealium account name at connection time; Relay encrypts the binding and agents cannot select another account.

credentialRequirements.name: TEALIUM_PROFILE
credentialRequirements.label: Tealium profile name
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind one exact Tealium profile name at connection time; Relay encrypts the binding and agents cannot select another profile.

capabilities.label: Read definition readiness summary
capabilities.description: Count audience and badge definitions for one exact account/profile while excluding definition identity, names, visitor data, and configuration.

approvalRequired.label: Get Tealium definition readiness summary
approvalRequired.description: Return only audience-definition and badge-definition counts for the exact bound profile.

blocked.label: Access definition identity or names
blocked.description: Account/profile values, audience and badge IDs/names, definitions, rules, conditions, enrichments, and activation details remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access visitors, identities, events, or attributes
blocked.description: Visitors, visitor IDs, identities, devices, events, sessions, attributes, badges, audiences, consent, locations, and raw customer data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access configuration, tags, or integrations
blocked.description: iQ profiles, variables, tags, templates, extensions, load rules, events, versions, connectors, data sources, destinations, hosted data layers, and credentials remain blocked.

blocked.label: Create, update, delete, or administer Tealium
blocked.description: Publishing, Collect ingestion, audience or attribute changes, tag/profile/configuration changes, users, permissions, API keys, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use authenticated, raw, or bulk APIs
blocked.description: V3 authentication, API keys, arbitrary accounts/profiles/regions/origins/paths/methods/headers/queries/bodies, Visitor Profile/Privacy, DataAccess, Collect, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded public definition-count read requires approval; identity, visitor data, configuration, writes, authenticated APIs, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded public read runs directly; exact account/profile binding, redaction, response cap, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed account/profile-bound identity-free Tealium definition-count wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed Tealium wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: The customer must identify an eligible AudienceStream account/profile whose public Profile Definition endpoint is enabled and complete a live read-only acceptance check.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin supplies the exact account/profile binding, confirms public Profile Definition availability and policy suitability, and completes live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Tealium documents the public fixed GET visitor-service.tealiumiq.com/datacloudprofiledefinitions/{account}/{profile} endpoint and a response containing audience and badge IDs and names without a specific visitor.
Tealium documents separate authenticated V3 APIs using username/API-key exchange, bearer tokens, and returned region-specific hosts; Relay excludes that broader credentialed surface from V1.
Tealium documents broader Collect, iQ Profiles, Visitor Privacy, and Visitor Profile API families, which remain outside this public read-only V1.

securityNotes: Relay stores only the exact account/profile binding and no Tealium API key, username, bearer token, visitor identifier, or provider credential.

Relay allowlists only GET https://visitor-service.tealiumiq.com/datacloudprofiledefinitions/{bound-account}/{bound-profile}/, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, caps responses at 1 MB, and accepts no runtime input.
Output contains only audience-definition and badge-definition counts; account/profile values, audience/badge IDs and names, rules, conditions, visitor data, and raw response fields are excluded.

Authenticated V3 APIs, Visitor Profile/Privacy, DataAccess, Collect ingestion, iQ configuration, publishing, arbitrary APIs, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.
Account/profile selection, public-endpoint suitability confirmation, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
